verdict.rationale: FireHydrant is an incident-management SaaS, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence points to an official FireHydrant MCP server repo (github.com/firehydrant/firehydrant-mcp), confirmed by a probe. A freshworks-oss repo's Speakeasy-generated OpenAPI document describes 'An MCP server for interacting with FireHydrant's API' spanning the broad API surface. missing for 10: first-party docs on setup, auth and client configuration, an enumerated tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully.
